statutoryAuthority.ruleStatement: If someone was arrested or convicted under the name of a person whose identity was stolen or used without authorization, the aggrieved person may petition the chief judge of the circuit where the arrest occurred to correct the arrest or conviction and the official records by removing their name and substituting the offender's name if known. The committed route contract records the mechanism as a nunc pro tunc correction, removal and sealing mechanism with no elapsed waiting period: the verified petition may be filed upon learning of the record. It is not an ordinary conviction-expungement clock and is not routed through the ordinary expungement eligibility engine.
doNotImport: Do not route this matter through the ordinary Illinois expungement or sealing eligibility engine, waiting periods or exclusion lists; the route contract forbids it.
Do not substitute an ordinary expungement or sealing instrument, an official Illinois form or an invented form; no committed record names an official participant form for this route.
Do not treat a prostitution record on this route; the route contract records it as the separate branch of the same decision (IL:felony-prostitution-relief).
Do not invent a filing fee, a fee waiver, a service requirement, a copy count or a hearing rule; no committed record this family binds establishes any of them.
Do not decide that the record was in fact made in the participant's name by another person; that is the participant's verified allegation and the whole premise of the route.

captionContract.documentTitle: ILLINOIS VERIFIED MISTAKEN-IDENTITY PETITION UNDER 20 ILCS 2630/5.2

sections.heading: A. REQUEST FOR MISTAKEN-IDENTITY CORRECTION
sections.body: I petition the chief judge under the mistaken-identity provisions of 20 ILCS 2630/5.2 to correct records made in my name through identity theft or unauthorized use of my identity. The facts and supporting records are described below.

sections.heading: C. CASE INFORMATION TO COMPLETE BEFORE SIGNING

fieldLabels.identity_theft_report_and_mismatched_ide: [C1 - identity theft report and mismatched identifiers] Describe the affected record and how the identifiers show that someone else used your name. Identify the attached identity-theft report and supporting identifier evidence.
fieldLabels.arrest_circuit: [C2 - arrest circuit] Illinois circuit where the arrest occurred
fieldLabels.automatic_seal_status: [C6 - automatic-seal status] State the record's automatic-seal status. If uncertain, ask the circuit clerk or get legal help before filing.

sections.heading: D. RELIEF REQUESTED
sections.body: I ask the chief judge to correct the arrest or conviction and official records by removing my name and substituting the offender's name if known.

sections.heading: E. CERTIFICATION UNDER 735 ILCS 5/1-109
sections.body:
Under penalties as provided by law pursuant to Section 1-109 of the Code of Civil Procedure, I certify that the statements set forth in this petition are true and correct, except as to matters stated to be on information and belief and as to such matters I certify that I verily believe the same to be true.

(Sign and date personally after completing and checking this petition. No notarization is required by this certification.)

documents.title: Filing Instructions

sections.heading: FILING INSTRUCTIONS - ILLINOIS VERIFIED MISTAKEN-IDENTITY PETITION UNDER 20 ILCS 2630/5.2
sections.body:
This page is for {{participant_full_legal_name}}.

PURPOSE AND FILING COURT

Use this petition for criminal identity theft or mistaken identity under 20 ILCS 2630/5.2. Petition the chief judge of the Illinois circuit where the arrest occurred. This is a record-correction process; an ordinary expungement petition is not a substitute.

BEFORE YOU SIGN

Obtain the identity-theft report and evidence showing the mismatch between your identifiers and those in the affected arrest or conviction record. Attach these records to the petition.

Complete C1, C2 and C6 and the arrest-circuit caption from accurate records. Do not guess case facts, dates or an unknown offender's name.

Review the entire completed petition and its certification under 735 ILCS 5/1-109. Sign and date personally only if its statements are true. The certification does not require a notary.

Leave a new court-assigned case number blank until the court supplies it.

FILING COST AND WAIVER

Confirm the current filing fee and any fee-waiver procedure with the office of the chief judge of the Illinois circuit where the arrest occurred. This packet does not establish a fee amount or a waiver decision. If you cannot afford a fee, ask about available waiver procedures or legal aid; do not assume inability to pay bars filing.

NOTICE AND SERVICE

Before filing, ask the office of the chief judge of the arrest circuit who must receive notice or service, how to provide it, and whether proof of service is required. Follow the court's instructions; this packet does not certify that anyone has been served.

WHEN TO GET LEGAL HELP

- you are uncertain that someone else used your identity to create the record;
- the arrest or conviction is actually your own, rather than a mistaken-identity record;
- the record may already have been automatically sealed and its status is unresolved;
- you need relief on the separate prostitution or trafficking-related conviction route;
- an immigration issue is involved.

factsRemovedByReviewFinding.bindingRule: Keep this petition and its collection/handback specific to the supported mistaken-identity branch. Model applicability explicitly for any retained conditional facts, keep the separate prostitution routing stop, and do not impose a conviction waiting clock or fabricate sentence facts. factsRemovedByReviewFinding.why: Each was requiredBeforeFiling with no applicability condition, on a route whose own doNotImport says "Do not treat a prostitution record on this route". A participant correcting a record another person created in their name may have no conviction, no sentence and no trafficking facts to give, and was being asked to swear to them. The repaired artifact prints C1, C2 and C6 only; this removes the collection that matched the old page.
factsRemovedByReviewFinding.preservedIn: The removed declarations are preserved in git history and in the VF07 return that condemned them.
factsRemovedByReviewFinding.alsoCorrected: postFilingTimeline step 1 told the participant to "fill Items C1 to C6 of the petition".
